udp_ip_rx_64.summary: 64-bit UDP receiver: a 5-state FSM latches parallel IP header fields, extracts the UDP header from the first payload word, then forwards length-trimmed payload through a skid-buffered AXI stream.

blocks.name: rx_fsm
blocks.description: FSM sequencing header accept, UDP header parse, payload forwarding and discard

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Main FSM: idle, read header, read payload, payload last, wait last; drives readies and stores

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_ready
anchors.why: IP header ready asserted in idle when no UDP header pending

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input payload ready from FSM and skid-buffer availability

anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: UDP header valid raised after first payload word is parsed

blocks.name: header_registers
blocks.description: Latched IP header fields and UDP fields from first payload word

anchors.name: store_ip_hdr
anchors.why: Latches all parallel IP header fields when header is accepted

anchors.name: store_hdr_word_0
anchors.why: Loads UDP ports, length and checksum from first payload word

anchors.name: m_ip_source_ip_reg
anchors.why: Representative latched IP header field register driving output header

anchors.name: m_udp_length_reg
anchors.why: Representative UDP header field register extracted from first payload word

blocks.name: payload_length
blocks.description: Remaining byte counter with tkeep trimming and last-word hold

anchors.name: word_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining payload bytes from UDP length; trims tkeep and detects early termination

anchors.name: last_word_data_reg
anchors.why: Holds final payload word while trailing padding is discarded

blocks.name: output_skid_buffer
blocks.description: Two-register skid buffer driving output UDP payload AXI stream

anchors.name: temp_m_udp_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp register holding payload while output stalls

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tready_int_early
anchors.why: Early ready from skid buffer gating input payload ready

anchors.name: store_udp_payload_int_to_output
anchors.why: Skid buffer enable loading payload into output register

anchors.name: store_udp_payload_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Skid buffer enable storing payload into temp register on stall

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output UDP payload data from skid buffer output register

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output payload valid from skid buffer

blocks.name: error_status
blocks.description: Registered busy and early-termination error outputs

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy level while FSM is not idle

anchors.name: error_header_early_termination
anchors.why: Error pulse when tlast arrives in UDP header word

anchors.name: error_payload_early_termination
anchors.why: Error pulse when frame ends before UDP length

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_valid
ungrouped_anchors.why: IP header valid; accepted in idle to latch IP header fields

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tdata
ungrouped_anchors.why: 64-bit IP payload stream carrying UDP header word and payload

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tkeep
ungrouped_anchors.why: Input byte keep, trimmed by remaining count and checked for early end

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
ungrouped_anchors.why: Input payload stream valid qualifying header and payload transfers

ungrouped_anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_ready
ungrouped_anchors.why: Downstream accepts UDP header, clearing header valid

ungrouped_anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tready
ungrouped_anchors.why: Downstream ready controlling skid buffer and input backpressure

axis_fifo.summary: AXI-Stream FIFO (64-bit, tkeep enabled): write logic packs beats into RAM via write/commit pointers; a read pipeline fetches via rd pointer to the output, with full/empty and depth status.

blocks.name: Write controller
blocks.description: Accepts input beats, writes mem, manages commit pointer and frame drop/mark logic.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Write pointer addressing mem, incremented on accepted input beats.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_commit_reg
anchors.why: Committed write pointer; frames become visible to reader once committed, used for empty.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready derived from full and drop/mark mode parameters.

anchors.name: full
anchors.why: Pointer MSB compare; deasserts s_axis_tready and triggers drop/mark.

anchors.name: full_wr
anchors.why: Frame overflow flag (frame mode only) forcing drop or send of oversize frame.

anchors.name: drop_frame_reg
anchors.why: Set while discarding the current frame; parameter-disabled in this config.

anchors.name: mark_frame_reg
anchors.why: Marks truncated frame bad via tlast/tuser override when full.

anchors.name: send_frame_reg
anchors.why: Forces commit of oversize frame beats in frame mode.

anchors.name: s_frame_reg
anchors.why: Tracks being inside an input frame for mark-when-full.

anchors.name: s_axis
anchors.why: Packed input word (data, tlast, tuser) written into mem.

blocks.name: FIFO RAM
blocks.description: Dual-pointer RAM storing packed stream beats.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: Main FIFO RAM holding packed tdata/tlast/tuser beats.

blocks.name: Read pipeline
blocks.description: Reads mem through RAM pipeline registers and drives the output stream handshake.

anchors.name: rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Read pointer addressing mem, incremented when a beat enters the output pipeline.

anchors.name: empty
anchors.why: Commit pointer equals read pointer; blocks read pointer increment.

anchors.name: m_axis_pipe_reg
anchors.why: RAM read pipeline stages carrying beats from mem to the output.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid_pipe_reg
anchors.why: Valid chain for the read pipeline stages; bubbles allow advance.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_pipe
anchors.why: Ready into the read pipeline enabling stage transfers and reads.

anchors.name: m_axis
anchors.why: Packed output word from last pipeline stage unpacked into fields.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output stream payload from last RAM pipeline stage.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid driven from valid pipeline, optionally gated by pause.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready advancing the output pipeline and read pointer.

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Output end-of-frame unpacked from stored beat.

blocks.name: Status
blocks.description: Registered depth and frame-event status outputs.

anchors.name: status_depth
anchors.why: FIFO occupancy output from registered write-read pointer difference.

anchors.name: status_depth_commit
anchors.why: Committed occupancy output from commit pointer minus read pointer.

anchors.name: status_overflow
anchors.why: Pulse reporting a dropped frame due to overflow.

anchors.name: status_bad_frame
anchors.why: Pulse reporting a dropped bad frame.

anchors.name: status_good_frame
anchors.why: Pulse reporting a committed good frame.

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
ungrouped_anchors.why: Input stream payload packed into s_axis and written to mem.

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_axis_tkeep
ungrouped_anchors.why: Input byte-enable sideband packed with each beat into mem.

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
ungrouped_anchors.why: Input valid; with tready triggers writes into mem.

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
ungrouped_anchors.why: Input end-of-frame stored with beat and steering frame tracking.

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_axis_tuser
ungrouped_anchors.why: Input user sideband stored with beat, overridden on marked frames.

udp_checksum_gen_64.summary: UDP checksum/length generator: an FSM sums pseudo-header and 64-bit payload words into a ones-complement checksum while payload is buffered in an AXI-stream FIFO and computed headers queue in a header FIFO.

blocks.name: Checksum FSM
blocks.description: Sequences header capture, payload summation and checksum finalization.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Sequences idle, header sum, payload sum and two finish-sum states.

anchors.name: store_udp_hdr
anchors.why: Latches all input header fields into holding registers on header accept.

anchors.name: shift_payload_in
anchors.why: Gates payload stream into FIFO and tready during payload sum state.

anchors.name: hdr_valid_reg
anchors.why: Checksum-complete pulse requesting header FIFO write.

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Level busy when FSM not idle.

blocks.name: Checksum datapath
blocks.description: Holds header fields and accumulates pseudo-header and payload ones-complement sum and length.

anchors.name: checksum_reg
anchors.why: Ones-complement checksum accumulator, finalized and written to header FIFO.

anchors.name: checksum_temp1_reg
anchors.why: Partial sum of low payload bytes feeding accumulator next cycle.

anchors.name: word_cnt
anchors.why: Valid byte count from tkeep added to length and checksum.

anchors.name: frame_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Counts UDP length bytes, stored as udp_length in header FIFO.

anchors.name: ip_dest_ip_reg
anchors.why: Representative latched header field, summed into pseudo-header checksum.

blocks.name: Header FIFO
blocks.description: Queues completed headers with length and checksum, drives output header registers.

anchors.name: udp_checksum_mem
anchors.why: Header FIFO memory (representative) storing computed checksums per frame.

anchors.name: header_fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Header FIFO write pointer addressing header memories.

anchors.name: header_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Header FIFO read pointer addressing header memories.

anchors.name: header_fifo_write
anchors.why: Writes header fields, length and checksum into header FIFO when not full.

anchors.name: header_fifo_read
anchors.why: Pops header FIFO into output registers when output free.

anchors.name: header_fifo_full
anchors.why: Blocks header FIFO write and input header ready.

anchors.name: header_fifo_empty
anchors.why: Blocks header read and clears output header valid.

blocks.name: Payload FIFO
blocks.description: Buffers payload while checksum is computed, then streams it out.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Payload beat valid summed and pushed into payload FIFO.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Payload ready from FIFO ready gated by shift_payload_in.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Payload bytes summed into checksum and buffered in FIFO.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Byte enables selecting summed bytes and word count.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Buffered payload output from payload FIFO.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Payload FIFO output valid.

blocks.name: Header interfaces
blocks.description: Parallel UDP header input and output handshakes and computed fields.

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Input header valid starting a checksum computation.

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Input header ready in idle when header FIFO has room.

anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Output header valid when header FIFO entry loaded.

anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Output header ready enabling next header FIFO read.

anchors.name: m_udp_checksum
anchors.why: Computed UDP checksum output.

anchors.name: m_udp_length
anchors.why: Computed UDP length output.

anchors.name: m_ip_length
anchors.why: IP length derived from UDP length plus 20.

udp_ip_tx_64.summary: UDP transmit framer (64-bit): an FSM latches parallel UDP/IP header fields, emits the 8-byte UDP header word then forwards payload with length tracking and truncation, through a skid-buffered AXI-Stream output, passing IP header fields on.

blocks.name: Framing FSM
blocks.description: Sequences header capture, UDP header word and payload forwarding.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Controller: idle, write header, payload, payload-last, wait-last; drives readies and output mux.

anchors.name: store_udp_hdr
anchors.why: Latches all header fields into holding registers.

anchors.name: store_last_word
anchors.why: Captures current output word into last-word registers.

anchors.name: word_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining payload bytes; sets final tkeep and detects length mismatch.

blocks.name: Header registers
blocks.description: Latched IP pass-through fields and UDP header fields.

anchors.name: udp_source_port_reg
anchors.why: Representative latched UDP header field emitted in header word.

anchors.name: m_ip_length
anchors.why: IP total length computed as UDP length plus 20.

anchors.name: m_eth_dest_mac
anchors.why: Representative passed-through Ethernet/IP header field output.

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: IP header valid output set when header stored.

blocks.name: Payload datapath
blocks.description: Selects header word, payload or held last word for output.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata_int
anchors.why: Internal output data mux: UDP header bytes, payload or last word.

anchors.name: last_word_data_reg
anchors.why: Holds last payload word while discarding excess input.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input UDP payload data forwarded to IP payload output.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input payload valid; advances word counting.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Payload ready from registered FSM ready.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End of input payload; detects early termination, returns to idle.

blocks.name: Output skid buffer
blocks.description: Two-register AXI-Stream output buffer.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output IP payload: UDP header word then payload.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output payload valid from skid buffer register.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready controlling skid buffer transfers.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Internal ready from output buffer gating FSM transfers.

anchors.name: temp_m_ip_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp slot for output data.

anchors.name: store_ip_payload_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads internal data into output registers.

blocks.name: Status
blocks.description: Busy and early-termination error flags.

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy when FSM not idle.

anchors.name: error_payload_early_termination
anchors.why: Payload ended before UDP length reached.

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_valid
ungrouped_anchors.why: UDP header valid; starts frame and header capture.

ungrouped_anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_ready
ungrouped_anchors.why: Downstream header ready clears header valid.

udp_64.summary: 64-bit UDP block: an RX instance strips UDP headers from incoming IP frames, while the TX path chains a checksum generator (payload/header FIFOs) into a UDP-to-IP framer, all with header and payload AXI-Stream handshakes.

blocks.name: UDP receive
blocks.description: udp_ip_rx_64 parses UDP header from IP payload and outputs UDP header plus payload.

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Valid of incoming IP header bundle into the UDP receiver.

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Receiver accepts incoming IP header.

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Incoming IP payload stream carrying UDP header and data to receiver.

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Valid of incoming IP payload stream.

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Receiver backpressure on incoming IP payload.

anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Valid of decoded UDP header bundle output by the receiver.

anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Downstream accepts received UDP header.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Received UDP payload stream output.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Valid of received UDP payload stream.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream backpressure on received UDP payload.

anchors.name: rx_busy
anchors.why: Receiver busy level from UDP RX instance.

anchors.name: rx_error_header_early_termination
anchors.why: Receiver error: frame ended inside UDP header.

anchors.name: rx_error_payload_early_termination
anchors.why: Receiver error: payload shorter than UDP length.

blocks.name: UDP checksum generator
blocks.description: udp_checksum_gen_64 computes length and checksum, buffering payload and headers in FIFOs.

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Valid of outgoing UDP header bundle into checksum generator.

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Checksum generator accepts outgoing UDP header.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Outgoing UDP payload stream summed and buffered by checksum generator.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Valid of outgoing UDP payload stream.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Checksum generator backpressure on outgoing UDP payload.

anchors.name: tx_udp_checksum
anchors.why: Computed UDP checksum passed from generator into the TX framer.

anchors.name: tx_udp_length
anchors.why: Computed UDP length from generator feeding the TX framer.

blocks.name: UDP transmit framer
blocks.description: udp_ip_tx_64 prepends the UDP header word and emits an IP frame with protocol 0x11.

anchors.name: tx_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Internal header valid from checksum generator to TX framer.

anchors.name: tx_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Buffered payload stream from checksum generator to TX framer.

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Valid of outgoing IP header bundle from the UDP framer.

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Downstream accepts outgoing IP header.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Outgoing IP payload stream carrying UDP header plus data.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Valid of outgoing IP payload stream.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream backpressure on outgoing IP payload.

anchors.name: tx_busy
anchors.why: Transmitter busy level from UDP TX framer.

anchors.name: tx_error_payload_early_termination
anchors.why: Transmitter error: payload shorter than UDP length.
